4 · Publish the fingerprint

One transaction records the fingerprint, the count and your label on X Layer. Until you do this, verifiers will show “not registered”.

Your skill challenge

Build a circuit from NAND gates that produces the table below. This table is unique to you. Click an output dot, then an input dot, to wire. Double-click a gate or a wire to remove it.

ABCY

Your circuit matches. Put it on TapeOut.

This mints your circuit on X Layer. NAND transistors are free from the faucet (once per wallet). The network fee is about 0.0013 OKB.

Revoke

Withdraw a single certificate, or a whole batch. Only the wallet that published the batch can do this. The change is public and permanent.

Certificate

Scan to verify. Anyone can check this certificate against the public record on X Layer.

No personal data is stored on-chain: only a batch fingerprint, a count and a label. The format is public (docs/FORMAT.md), so anyone can write their own verifier. Hackathon MVP, contracts unaudited.
